## What's new

**👥 Separate data for each Discord account** ([#8](https://github.com/mPhpMaster/FriendsInVoice/pull/8))
- If you run two Discords on one computer with different accounts, or switch accounts in one Discord, each account now has its own My list, alert lists, Run away list, Hidden list, Personal Guards and Log. Before, every account shared them and overwrote each other's.
- The first account that opens after you update keeps the lists you had before. Other accounts start empty.
- Options like notifications, smart replies, "Stay in voice" and "Never go idle" are still shared by all accounts.

**📜 Log tab** ([#4](https://github.com/mPhpMaster/FriendsInVoice/pull/4), [#7](https://github.com/mPhpMaster/FriendsInVoice/pull/7))
- A history of when friends, people on My list, or people in your room join, leave or move between voice rooms, with the time, person, room and server.
- People coming into or leaving the room you're in are tagged **YOUR ROOM**, even if they aren't your friends.
- Also logs friend requests, new friends, friends you lost, and servers you're no longer in.
- Filter by Friends, My list, My room, Me, or Friends & servers, then pick one server, one person, or a date and time range, or search by name.
- Saved on your computer, per account: the last 5,000 events, 50 per page.

**🙈 Hide someone from In voice** ([#3](https://github.com/mPhpMaster/FriendsInVoice/pull/3))
- Right-click a user → **Hide from In voice**. They stop showing up in In voice and don't count in the badge. Bring them back from the chips under In voice.

Everything is in the BetterDiscord version too.

## Update

Vencord: click the new-version notification on Windows or macOS, or download `FriendsInVoice-v1.14.0.zip` and run `install.bat` on Windows or `install.command` / `bash install.sh` on macOS. If you use two Discords, open your main account first after updating.

BetterDiscord: replace your plugin file with `FriendsInVoice.plugin.js` from this release.

## Verification

Vencord TypeScript check and lint passed, plus all 30 plugin tests and all 21 BetterDiscord port tests.
